questions.stem: In a bar chart, what does the height of each bar represent?
questions.explanation: In a bar chart, the height (or length) of each bar represents the frequency — the number of times each category or value occurs.

questions.stem: In a pictogram, each symbol represents $4$ items. How many symbols are needed to show $14$ items?
questions.explanation: $14 \div 4 = 3.5$ symbols. In a pictogram, the half symbol represents $2$ items.
